name: FPP 9.x
description: Falcon Player (FPP) is a lightweight, optimized software designed to run on single-board computers and x86 systems for controlling pixel lighting sequences. FPP 9.x is the current stable release.

notes.text: FPP requires a privileged container for hardware and systemd access.
Installation compiles FPP from source and takes 15–30 minutes depending on CPU speed.
FPP is officially supported only on Raspberry Pi and BeagleBone. x86/LXC installs are community-supported.
